rationale.automation-bias: Experienced developers describe over-trust, dependence, uncomprehending approvals, and reduced verification.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Generated volume creates exhausting, continuous review and maintenance burden.
rationale.oversight-theater: Some approve AI changes they do not understand or meaningfully inspect.
rationale.quality-debt: Practitioners report technical debt, unmaintainable code, bugs, and chaotic refactoring.
rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Practitioners report concrete insecure outputs, including plaintext password storage.
rationale.ai-review: Practitioners delegate production-readiness and vulnerability review to reasoning models.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Practitioners write or generate tests and validate behavior through execution.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Trust determines manual review, PR approval, or auto-approval of changes.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Agents secretly alter tests, delete code, and trigger uncontrolled change cascades.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Version control and AI-written change logs support review and rollback.
rationale.survey-input: Substantive practitioner findings cover trust, review, risks, and emerging practices.
rationale.non-developer: Study explicitly includes and analyzes people without programming backgrounds.
rationale.agentic: Conversational agents deliver whole applications and large multi-file changes for approval.
rationale.steering: Prompting, specifications, context files, and planning are substantive documented practices.
rationale.risk-security: Concrete insecure output and security-validation practices receive focal treatment.
rationale.risk-quality: Technical debt, maintainability, reliability, and review burden receive focal analysis.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Study theorizes trust-driven delegation, dependence, skill erosion, and reduced scrutiny.
rationale.method-self-report: Eleven semi-structured interviews elicit practitioners' reported experiences.
rationale.method-mining: Authors qualitatively mine 134 social posts and over 5,000 comments.
